portfolio.title: Legal document Q&A agent
portfolio.what: Upload a set of public legal documents (court opinions or sample contracts), ask questions, get answers with citations, and run a multi-agent review that flags documents as relevant or not with a reason.

steps.title: LangGraph workflow: router → retriever → reviewer → answer with citations, with a human-approval step
OpenSearch hybrid search (BM25 + kNN) with metadata filters
Bedrock (or another LLM API) for generation and embeddings
React frontend with streaming answers and a visible trace of agent steps
Audit log table: every query, retrieved doc IDs, tool calls, user
Terraform for S3, ECR, ECS or Lambda, API Gateway, CloudFront
A small eval set (20 questions) with a faithfulness score in the README
Write down one design decision you'd change for a real client (e.g. per-matter index isolation)

portfolio.cut: If short on time: run OpenSearch in Docker locally instead of AWS; deploy only the backend with Terraform; skip CodePipeline.

questionsForThem: Which clients and use cases is the team building for now?

How are agent outputs validated before clients rely on them?
What does the first 90 days look like?
